I changed the standard scoping conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The `codeanalyzer` module tests pass, but I didn't add any tests for the new rules. I also didn't run a scan on sample paths such as `.gitignore` or `src/.config/Foo.java`.

- **Ignore rules:** I replaced the "Hidden files and folders" rule with `(.*/)?[.](git|svn|hg|bzr)/.*`. It ignores the contents of those version-control folders at any depth, including a path that starts directly with `.git/`. Plain dotfiles and other dotted folders are no longer ignored. I removed the `dependencies` rule. The `.yarn/releases`, `.yarn/plugins`, `node_modules` and `vendor` rules are unchanged.
- **Build-and-deployment scope:** I added `(.*/)?[.](idea|vscode|vs|gradle|mvn|settings|metadata|circleci)/.*`. Files under those folders at any depth now go into that scope instead of being ignored.

I didn't commit anything.
